About InterDigital

InterDigital is a global research and development company focused primarily on wireless, video, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and related technologies. We design and develop foundational technologies that enable connected, immersive experiences in a broad range of communications and entertainment products and services. We license our innovations worldwide to companies providing such products and services, including makers of wireless communications devices, consumer electronics, IoT devices, cars and other motor vehicles, and providers of cloud-based services such as video streaming. As a leader in wireless technology, our engineers have designed and developed a wide range of innovations that are used in wireless products and networks, from the earliest digital cellular systems to 5G and today’s most advanced Wi-Fi technologies. We are also a leader in video processing and video encoding/decoding technology, with a significant AI research effort that intersects with both wireless and video technologies. Founded in 1972, InterDigital is listed on Nasdaq. InterDigital is a registered trademark of InterDigital, Inc.

For more information, visit: https://www.interdigital.com/

Summary

Provides end-to-end technical support and service to end users related to network infrastructure, internal desktop, productivity and collaboration tools, and business applications. Installs, configures, repairs and/or troubleshoots desktop systems and network issues in a heterogeneous environment. Participates in the development of Information Services and infrastructure projects. Assists with the conduct of training programs to end users on basic or specialized applications or systems.

This role will begin September / October 2026.

This is a hybrid position requiring 4 days in the Conshohocken, PA office.

Please indicate your availability in the questionnaire.

Potential to be extended into 2027.

Job Responsibilities

- Act as a first level problem identification and resolution resource, including answering questions, providing advice, investigating, troubleshooting, and following-up to assist users in solving data processing problems.

- Responds to Help Desk issues and documents resolution and any pertinent information.

- Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention with IS staff to take appropriate action either by phone, remote, or on-site as necessary to address day-to-day problems for resolution.

- Provides desktop hardware, software, phone system and conferencing support to all corporate users.

- Install, configure, and troubleshoot problems associated with systems including PC’s, laptops, printers, mobile devices, network interfaces, cabling, docking stations and peripheral components such as displays, keyboards, printers, USB and disk drives.

- Install, configure, and troubleshoot standard software applications in support of corporate users including but not limited to Microsoft Office suites, browsers, remote access, readers, VPN clients, and viewers.

- Maintains video conferencing equipment or phone systems and supported cabling.

- Assists in the implementation of preventive maintenance plans for all equipment.

- Maintains user accounts.

- Maintains computer supplies for desktop support and updates inventory in coordination with IS Administrator or Coordinator.

- Assists with daily support and maintenance of backup operations as needed.

- Collaborates with other members and projects in different IS teams.

- Assists in the on-going development of customer service standards. Supports and responds to meet established service standards.

- Create and maintain knowledge base documentation for IS department.

Qualifications:

- Exceptional customer service skills.

- Good verbal/written communication skills and be capable of relating technical information to different types of individuals.

- Self-motivated and ability to multi-task.

- Able to set priorities, resolve customer issues and meet individual deadlines while accomplishing team objectives in a timely manner.

- Solve difficult and complex problems independently and as a team.

- Follow SOP and assist in construction of Standard Operating Procedures.

- Efficiency in O365 applications.

- General knowledge of Active Directory and ticketing systems.

- Create PowerShell scripts a plus.

- Create customizations via SQL a plus.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

This is a general application used to fill multiple internship openings across our Infotainment and Mobile Applications teams. If selected, you will be matched to a specific team based on your background and interests during the interview process.

Role Summary

When a driver taps navigation, plays music, speaks to the voice assistant, connects Bluetooth, or receives a software update, that experience was built by an infotainment and mobile applications team. As an intern on this team, you will contribute to the customer facing software running inside software-defined vehicles, spanning Android platform work, in vehicle applications, wireless and telematics integration, visual and graphics features, or the automation and integration testing that supports these systems.

Specific project areas vary by team and may include:

- Developing Android Automotive applications such as navigation, media, or vehicle settings

- Contributing to Android platform or system level software, including HAL development or system stability work

- Building wireless or telematics software connecting the vehicle to mobile apps and cloud services

- Supporting 3D graphics or visual experience features using tools such as Unreal Engine or OpenGL

- Writing automated test suites and integration tests for infotainment features

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and test software features within an existing infotainment, mobile, or connectivity application

- Write code in Kotlin, Java, C++, or Python depending on the team

- Collaborate with product and design partners to understand feature requirements

- Debug and resolve issues found during development or testing

- Present your work and progress to your team throughout the internship

Qualifications

Minimum:

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program at an accredited US university

- Proficiency in Kotlin, Java, C++, or Python

Preferred:

- Actively pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, with intent to return to school after the internship

- Experience developing Android applications or familiarity with the Android Automotive OS framework

- Coursework or project experience with wireless protocols such as LTE, Wi-Fi, or BLE

- Exposure to 3D graphics engines such as Unreal Engine, OpenGL, or Vulkan

- Familiarity with test automation frameworks

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

This role will assist with maintaining project timelines, documentation, status reporting, and meeting coordination to help ensure projects remain organized and on schedule. The intern will work closely with cross-functional technology, business, and operational teams while gaining exposure to enterprise systems, IT program management, and project delivery processes. Responsibilities include tracking project milestones, risks, and dependencies, organizing dashboards and project artifacts, and contributing to process improvement initiatives that enhance workflow efficiency and project visibility. This internship is ideal for candidates interested in technology project management, enterprise systems, venue technology, or IT operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Support project coordination for enterprise technology initiatives, including project timelines, task tracking, and stakeholder updates.
- Assist the Enterprise Technology PMO team with maintaining project documentation, status reports, and meeting notes to ensure visibility across cross-functional teams.
- Help track project milestones, risks, and dependencies across enterprise systems and technology programs.
- Participate in project meetings and support communication between technology, business,
- and operational stakeholders.
- Assist with organizing project artifacts, dashboards, and project management tools used to monitor progress.
- Contribute to process improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline project workflows and documentation practices.
- Interest in technology project management, enterprise systems, venue technology or IT program management.

Qualifications

- Prior internship, coursework, or academic project exposure to project management, hospitality or retail operations or technology initiatives is a plus.
- Interest in technology project management, enterprise systems, venue technology or IT program management.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams); familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Asana is a plus.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty with energy and enthusiasm. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Technology Management, Project Management, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Interest in technology project management, enterprise systems, or IT program management.
- Prior internship, coursework, or academic project exposure to project management, business operations, or technology initiatives is a plus.

Skills and Abilities

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Interest in learning project management methodologies, tools, and PMO processes.
- Ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams); familiarity with project management tools is a plus.

#WeAreONEOK – Fortune 500 company. 100+ years in business. Leading midstream service provider. Safety first. Sustainable operations. Environmentally responsible. Employee focused.

JOB SUMMARY

The Terminal Operator Intern supports daily terminal operations while learning industry standards, safety practices, and equipment procedures. Work is performed under close supervision, with tasks that are structured, routine, and instructional in nature. The intern follows established processes, assists experienced operators, and gradually develops technical understanding of product handling, facility operations, and terminal systems. Decision‑making responsibilities are minimal, and guidance is provided for all assignments as the intern builds foundational knowledge and hands‑on skills.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

- Supports product measurement activities by assisting with gauging petroleum products transferred to and from tanks, trucks, rail cars, pipelines, and, where applicable, marine vessels, under direct supervision.
- Learns and assists with valve lineups, switches, and tank changes required for the safe and efficient movement of petroleum products in and out of storage tanks.
- Follows safety protocols and works alongside experienced operators to help prevent spills, product contamination, and product loss.
- Inputs basic product or operational data into terminal automation systems (e.g., ATLAS, TopTech) while developing proficiency and accuracy.
- Participates in routine inspections, including tank checks, equipment observations, and facility walkdowns; helps record findings and supports corrective actions as directed.
- Assists with general facility upkeep, such as maintaining location appearance, supporting minor equipment repairs, and helping ensure compliance with operational standards.
- Supports customer and driver interactions, and assists with vessel, truck, and rail rack operations as assigned by qualified personnel.
- Performs assigned project and administrative tasks in support of terminal operations and training objectives.
- May assist with Department of Transportation (DOT)–covered functions under supervision, including operations, maintenance, or emergency response activities associated with pipelines or terminal systems. Intern must remain alert to safety hazards at all times and follow all safety procedures to avoid injury or property damage.

Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a Power Plant Operator, Chemical Plant Operator, or related program.
- Interest in terminal operations and energy industry.
- Ability to work outdoors and in varying conditions.
- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
- Valid driver’s license preferred.

What You’ll Gain

- Practical experience in terminal operations and maintenance.
- Understanding of regulatory compliance and safety standards.
- Mentorship from experienced professionals.
- Opportunity to develop technical and problem-solving skills.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

- Ability to: communicate effectively orally and in writing in English
- Ability to: communicate effectively with supervisors, co-workers, internal and external customers
- Ability to: work in stressful and changing environmental conditions (conditions as noted above)

- Ability to: compile and/or examine information and select the best action from defined alternatives

About Us

Fluxergy is a rapidly growing in vitro diagnostics company innovating on the cutting-edge of laboratory testing. We’re developing the first and only multi-modal point-of-care platform that enables molecular, clinical chemistry, immunoassay, and hematology testing on the same system.

Our platform spans many markets including the clinical, veterinary, and food safety industries. We are seeking self-motivated problem solvers who are excited to help decentralize traditional laboratory infrastructure.

At the core of our company’s identity is a strong foundation in engineering. We take great pride in our commitment to critical thinking and pragmatic problem-solving through a modular and systemic perspective. We hold the conviction that transparent communication, coupled with the flexibility to adjust to evolving scenarios and the willingness to venture beyond familiar territories, is crucial to both our success and yours.

Our product: https://vimeo.com/176673475

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Firmware Engineering Intern to support embedded systems and firmware development efforts for MK14 daughter board platforms in a collaborative engineering environment. This internship offers hands-on experience working with hardware interfaces, firmware testing, system setup, and embedded software development processes.

The intern will work closely with engineering teams to support firmware development activities, improve testing workflows, and contribute to system reliability and documentation efforts. This role is ideal for students interested in embedded systems, electronics, low-level programming, and hardware-software integration.

What You Will Do

- Assist with environment setup and embedded system configuration activities

- Develop an understanding of MK14 daughter board architecture and system functionality

- Support test harness development and execution for firmware validation

- Review hardware datasheets and technical specifications to support development activities

- Contribute to technical documentation and maintain organized engineering records

- Participate in unit testing and firmware verification efforts

- Assist with debugging, error handling, and logging implementation

- Collaborate with engineers to identify opportunities to improve firmware development speed and efficiency

- Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis of firmware and hardware integration issues

What You'll Need to Have

- Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in:

- Computer Engineering

- Electrical Engineering

- Or a related technical discipline

- Availability to work approximately 30-40 hours per week

- Proficiency in C/C++ programming

- Exposure to RTOS (Real-Time Operating System) concepts

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a technical team

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

- Previous experience with firmware or embedded systems development

- Familiarity with hardware debugging tools and workflows

- Understanding of microcontrollers, communication protocols, or board-level systems

- Experience with unit testing or embedded software validation

- Exposure to version control tools such as Git

Interview Process

Our interview processes my differ slightly from role-to-role; however, most of our interviews will follow a similar pattern:

- Recruiter Interview

- Hiring Manager interview

- Decision

We are an early-stage company and may change our interview process from time-to-time, but our hope is everyone who interviews with us has a positive experience, even if an offer isn’t presented.

Benefits

A Work Culture Which Believes in Promoting from Within

- Wear lots of hats / accelerate your career growth!

- We are a flat organization by design – lots of visibility!

- Many of our current leaders started their career with Fluxergy!

Hourly Rate: $20/hour

Additional Information

Fluxergy is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic.

Overview:

Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com.

Job Description Summary:

Draper's Acoustic and Vibration Technologies group is seeking current undergraduate and graduate students to assist in the engineering of technology that solves critical problems of national importance. As an Acoustic Hardware Development Co-op, you will focus on the research and development of novel sensing and communication systems, including constituent sensors, electronics, and signal processing.

Job Description:

Duties/Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and enhancement engineering solutions for challenging problems.

- Implement, test, perform analysis, and provide documentation support.

- Generate and present test reports including plots, tables, evaluation criteria, and conclusions from data collected and analyzed throughout the test process.

- Complete assignments designed to develop a practical knowledge of processes, procedures, equipment, facilities, and systems as well as their interrelationships within engineering disciplines.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

Program Requirements

- Enrolled in an accredited engineering curriculum full-time undergraduate or graduate degree program required.

- Co-op Students must be able to work full-time for a 6 month period.

- There is flexibility regarding hours and program duration based on applicant’s school schedule and availability.

Skills/Abilities

- Excellent written and oral communication skills.

- Excellent work ethic with the ability to work independently or in a team environment.

- Ability to adapt to ever-changing environments, risks, and vulnerabilities.

- Strong computer skills including MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel.

Additional Job Description:

The ideal candidate will use their scientific education in acoustics or related disciplines to develop complex technology solutions, including:

- custom and COTS sensors that are used for advanced acoustic sensing and communication
- low-noise analog and digital signal conditioning hardware architectures
- embedded processors (FPGAs, microcontrollers, and ASICs) and DSP algorithms for filtering, classification, and control
- simulation and modeling of acoustic and other phenomenology that includes the relevant physics, sensors, and signal processing methods

Experience with any of the following engineering hardware and software tools is desired:

- C, C++, and/or MATLAB (Python) for algorithm development on a variety of devices and instruments
- LTspice, MATLAB (Python), Simulink, COMSOL and/or other multi-domain modeling applications
- Audio Precision, National Instruments, Liquid Instruments, and/or similar test and data acquisition systems

Candidates must be pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field with demonstrated coursework, research, and/or interest in the field acoustics.

KeyBanc Capital Markets

KeyBanc Capital Markets (KBCM) is a leading corporate and investment bank providing capital markets and advisory solutions to dynamic companies capitalizing on opportunities in changing industries. Our deep industry expertise, broad capabilities and unique ideas are seamlessly delivered to companies across the Consumer & Retail, Diversified Industries, Healthcare, Industrial, Oil & Gas, Real Estate, Utilities, Power & Renewables, and Technology verticals. With over 800 professionals across a national platform, KeyBanc Capital Markets has more than $30 billion of capital committed to clients and an award-winning Equity Research team that provides coverage on over 700 publicly traded companies.

The summer analyst program provides an excellent opportunity for senior-level banker and client exposure and higher, immediate “hands-on” experience.

About the Summer Analyst Program

KBCM provides its Summer Analysts unprecedented professional development opportunities through a mix of on-the-job training and structured, hands-on experience. The program is designed to provide broad experience across all stages of transaction executions, from pitch phase through closing. Because our Summer Analyst Program is a direct pipeline for our full-time Analyst positions, it offers exceptional potential for you to return to KBCM upon graduation to start your capital markets career.

Required Qualifications:

- Rising juniors enrolled in a four-year, undergraduate degree program with coursework in finance, economics or accounting graduating by May of 2028
- Minimum 3.5 GPA
- Strong quantitative and critical thinking abilities
- Demonstrated leadership and teamwork from past work experience and/or extracurricular activities
- Highly motivated with a strong work ethic
- Outstanding interpersonal, communication and presentation skills

Equity Research

The Equity Research group is responsible for producing analysis, recommendations, and reports on investment opportunities that institutional investors may be interested in. Our Senior Analysts specialize in specific industries, providing recommendations on public companies as well as expert knowledge on their sector. Our equity research coverage includes Basic Materials, Consumer, Energy, Healthcare, Industrial, Real Estate, and Technology.

This includes, for example, situations where a candidate may have temporary work authorization while enrolled in school or upon graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT) but would need H-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment in order to maintain employment eligibility.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This position is eligible to earn a weekly salary in the range of $1,340 to $1,440 per week depending on location and coverage group. Location:

San Jose

Employment Type:

Intern

Job Code:

Responsibilities

The Search team builds the systems that help users find relevant, reliable, and engaging content across TikTok. The team works across search retrieval, ranking, recommendation signals, query understanding, relevance, infrastructure, and product experiences. Our work combines large-scale machine learning, data-driven product development, and distributed systems to improve search quality for a global user base.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Support the design, implementation, testing, and iteration of Search features, services, or tools under the guidance of engineers and mentors.
- Work with large-scale data, logs, metrics, or experiments to understand user search behavior and improve product or system quality.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, data science, and machine learning partners to define requirements and deliver project milestones.
- Write clear, maintainable code and documentation for assigned workstreams.
- Communicate progress, risks, and learnings with mentors and stakeholders throughout the internship.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C++, Go, or JavaScript through coursework, projects, internships, or equivalent practical experience.
- Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, software engineering fundamentals, and basic system design concepts.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with search, recommendation, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, ranking, ads, content understanding, or data mining projects.
- Familiarity with databases, distributed systems, data pipelines, experimentation, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience using data to investigate product, user, or system problems.
- Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate with cross-functional partners.
- Interest in improving search experiences for large-scale consumer products.

As a condition of employment, all successful candidates must be able to establish authorization to work in the United States. For this position, the Company does not provide sponsorship or any immigration-related benefits.
